trapRootCause.verdict: managed heap exhaustion inside the embedded compiler, not a codegen range/allocator invariant
trapRootCause.evidence: N=1000 on key/join/index-fixed image v4: EXC_BREAKPOINT brk #3 at closures.ts:2380 (checker expression, chainReceiver closure allocation, 112 bytes) under checkClosureModule <- prepareCollectionPass <- prepareManagedJitProgram <- compileEntry, 271 s in. Faulting sequence: blr allocator callback; cmp w0,#1 (normal completion); ldr x9,[sp,#0x28]; cmp x9,#1; brk #3 with x9=0, i.e. the copying allocator returned undefined after collection could not free space.
trapRootCause.earlierPhase: On unfixed main the first minutes are in script-compile.ts:609 syntaxKey -> key.ts parts.join('|') over ~430k tokens (2,017,669 chars at N=1000): native join lowered to a concat loop (quadratic copying, string-concat-copy + copying-GC churn). Baseline v1 N=1000 ran the full 900 s watchdog without leaving syntaxKey.
